changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Update price_override status check constraint to allow new enum values: UNSCHEDULED, SCHEDULED, LIVE
changeSet.sql: -- Drop the old constraint first so updates can succeed ALTER TABLE price_override DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS price_override_status_check;
-- Migrate existing ACTIVE status to LIVE UPDATE price_override SET status = 'LIVE' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';
-- Migrate existing INACTIVE status to UNSCHEDULED UPDATE price_override SET status = 'UNSCHEDULED' WHERE status = 'INACTIVE';
-- Create new constraint with the new enum values ALTER TABLE price_override ADD CONSTRAINT price_override_status_check CHECK (status IN ('UNSCHEDULED', 'SCHEDULED', 'LIVE'));
